question: Can classical local Ising-energy annealing solve unfamiliar compositional signed-XOR constraint systems substantially faster than optimized exact classical solvers while retaining exact global-optimum quality and outperforming equal-start conventional descent?
hypothesis: A fixed 12-start, 60-sweep classical annealer on a nonconvex frustrated binary factor graph will reach the true optimum on at least 90% of 36 fresh worlds, outperform equally initialized zero-temperature local descent by >=10 percentage points, random search by >=30 points, and solve at <=half the whole graph-generation-plus-solve wall time of exact HiGHS MILP and NumPy exhaustive enumeration.
predecessor_evidence: ENERGY-38 DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, scored 54 synthetic causal worlds; energy-guided intervention selector failed 5/7 gates and lost exact causal-effect and compute efficiency comparisons. Parent archive at 623926aa14aa615dbfbe56ac9e5d4c28a0fcdc63.

inputs.name: Original synthetic frustrated weighted XOR2 constraint worlds
inputs.source: Self-authored deterministic SHA256-keyed source; no private data, protected model, paid API, or independent dataset.

frozen_design.source_generator: Connected cycle skeleton plus 2n additional edges per n variables; family-specific pair ordering (Erdos uniform SHA256 rank, modular same-block-priority, lattice short-ring-distance-priority) with stable hash tie, for exactly 3n edges. A planted hidden binary assignment sets edge parity; independent SHA256-keyed per-edge Bernoulli 22% parity frustration, positive integer weights 1..4. Solvers are given only complete public [(i,j,expected_xor,weight)] factors; planted assignment never passed to any solver.
frozen_design.anneal: Classical Ising Metropolis annealing, E(x)=sum_e w_e*[x_i XOR x_j != expected_e]; 12 deterministic seeded random starts, 60 sweeps, each sweep visits n variables in seeded random order; temperature geometrically from 3.0 down to 0.04; accepting downhill/neutral and uphill with exp(-deltaE/T). Record best encountered sweep state. No model training.
frozen_design.greedy: Identical 12 starts and sweep order as anneal, same 60 sweeps, flips strictly improving only; no uphill flips. The annealer consumes additional random draws for Metropolis decisions, so subsequent proposal permutations can differ, but starts and number of sweeps match.
frozen_design.random: 12*(60+1)=732 independently sampled uniformly random complete assignments, score minimum, SHA256 seeded. Not exactly compute-matched; actual cost measured.
frozen_design.highs: SciPy 1.17.0 HiGHS mixed-integer solver, exact binary x_i,carry z_e,parity p_e, equality x_i+x_j-2*z_e-p_e=0 for each factor; objective sum_e w_e*penalty, MILP time limit 2.0 seconds per graph, mip_rel_gap 0.0 and presolve true. Only status 0 success is an exact certification; failure/timeout must be recorded separately.
frozen_design.enumerate: NumPy vectorized exhaustive search over 2^(n-1) assignments with global XOR symmetry fixed x0=0; true exact optimum verified by an independently implemented all-case oracle in audit.py.
frozen_design.evaluator: Lowest total integer violated edge weight; an instance 'optimal' iff solver cost equals independently exhaustively verified global optimum. Track all 36 exact-optimal successes, total integer excess, per family 12 and per size 18, HiGHS certificate and dual bound parity. Higher-level causal learning, cumulative memory, unseen semantic reasoning or neural training are not scored.
frozen_design.time_definition: Per policy sum across 36 worlds of measured graph-generation wall seconds (same per instance for each method) plus solver wall seconds including that solver's setup/evaluations. Also record pure solve time and complete all-arm experiment wall separately. No claim about physical Joules or GPU. Timings are single local environment observations, and threshold comparisons should not overstate statistical significance.
frozen_design.compute_budget: 12*60*n variable flip proposals per local-search policy; fixed 732 random candidates; HiGHS cutoff 2.0s per graph; exhaustive oracle full symmetry-reduced search; 36 worlds once, single unchanged-source replay allowed for determinism (timing excluded), independent full-audit with no model-source import.
frozen_design.hardware: Linux CPU, Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
frozen_design.deterministic_expected: Graph construction, exact candidate costs and anneal/greedy/random scores deterministic for pinned versions; measured timings are not stable.

controls: NumPy symmetry-reduced exact exhaustive optimization (strong gold solver; all 36 graphs)
HiGHS MILP optimized exact classical solver under 2.0s timeout and zero gap
Fixed-capacity equal-start zero-temperature greedy coordinate descent
metrics: 36-world exact optimum hit rate for each algorithm
gap in total violated weight over independently verified optimum
HiGHS exact solver certification and dual-bound congruence
12 worlds per family and 18 n=18 worlds optimum rates
cumulative whole-policy graph-generation-plus-solver component wall time versus exact baselines

frozen_gates.anneal_optimal_at_least_90pct: Anneal hits independent global optimum on >=90% of all 36 graphs.
frozen_gates.anneal_beats_greedy_10pp: Anneal has >=10 percentage-point higher exact-optimum hit rate than greedy over 36.
frozen_gates.anneal_beats_random_30pp: Anneal has >=30 percentage-point higher exact-optimum hit rate than random sample over 36.
frozen_gates.anneal_optimal_at_least_80pct_each_famil: Anneal optimal rate >=80% separately on all three graph families, 12 graphs each.
frozen_gates.anneal_optimal_at_least_80pct_n18: Anneal optimal rate >=80% on all n=18 graphs, 18 graphs.
frozen_gates.energy_speed_2x_vs_exact_enumeration: Anneal total generation+solve time <=50% of exhaustive enumeration generation+solve time over the same 36 graphs.
frozen_gates.energy_speed_2x_vs_highs_exact: All 36 HiGHS cases certified exact AND anneal total generation+solve time <=50% of exact HiGHS generation+solve time.
frozen_gates.highs_certifies_every_instance: HiGHS certifies an exact optimum on each of 36 cases; any timeout or non-certified result FAIL even when reference enumeration independently verifies the true optimum.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO only if all 8 frozen gates PASS and independent source-free audit PASS; still not native Yggdrasil or SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Explicitly present all passing/failed gates and failure cause; no selective benchmark claims.
classification_rules.negative: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO for any failed gate with valid source, controls and scores. Preserve negative evidence without post-primary retuning.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID for source/prereg identity mismatch, seed/split/count drift, no exhaustive reference, code/data tampering, incorrect HiGHS assertion or failed independent audit. Distinguish code-atlas CI infrastructure failures from the valid scientific negative.

prohibited_after_primary_run: no score-informed parameter or threshold tuning
no seed substitution or graph family reweighting
no redefinition of time or performance numerator
preregistration_note: Both scorer and independently authored auditor were committed first; the excluded smoke seed 99563 covered three worlds with 62 checks PASS. All 36 primary seeds have NOT been scored at this preregistration boundary. No optimizer parameter tuning on primary.
